name: NEDA (National Eating Disorders Association)
description: Screening tools, treatment resources, support groups, and helpline for eating disorders.

sections.title: About NEDA
sections.text: The National Eating Disorders Association (NEDA) is the largest nonprofit organization dedicated to supporting individuals and families affected by eating disorders. NEDA serves as a catalyst for prevention, cures, and access to quality care. The organization provides education, resources, and support while advocating for research and policies that increase understanding and improve treatment for eating disorders including anorexia nervosa, bulimia nervosa, binge eating disorder, and ARFID.

sections.title: NEDA Helpline and Support
sections.text: NEDA offers support through multiple channels. For crisis situations involving eating disorders, text NEDA to 741741 to connect with a trained Crisis Text Line counselor. The NEDA website provides a chat feature for non-crisis support and information. Helpline services can assist with finding treatment providers, understanding insurance coverage, locating support groups, and providing information about eating disorders. All services are free and confidential, staffed by trained volunteers who understand eating disorders.

sections.title: Screening and Assessment Tools
sections.text: NEDA provides free, confidential screening tools on their website to help individuals determine if they or a loved one may be struggling with an eating disorder. These evidence-based questionnaires cover symptoms of various eating disorders and disordered eating patterns. While screenings cannot provide a diagnosis, they can help identify warning signs and encourage people to seek professional evaluation. NEDA also offers resources for healthcare providers on recognizing and screening for eating disorders in clinical settings.

sections.title: Finding Treatment
sections.text: NEDA maintains a treatment provider directory that helps individuals find eating disorder specialists, treatment centers, and programs across the United States. The website provides guidance on different levels of care, from outpatient treatment to residential programs. NEDA offers information on navigating insurance coverage for eating disorder treatment, appealing denials, and understanding patients' rights. Resources include questions to ask treatment providers and information about evidence-based treatments for different types of eating disorders.

sections.title: Community and Support Groups
sections.text: NEDA facilitates peer support through online forums, virtual support groups, and connections to local resources. NEDA Walks bring together communities across the country to raise awareness and support for eating disorder prevention and recovery. The organization also provides resources specifically for parents, partners, and families supporting a loved one with an eating disorder, including guidance on communication, meal support, and self-care for caregivers. NEDA's National Eating Disorders Awareness Week each February provides opportunities for community education and advocacy.
